_comment: QI canonical spoken-pronunciation map. Spoken-only: rewrites text before TTS, NEVER changes printed/displayed text. Whole-word, case-insensitive. Owner: Renne (Quiddity Innovations).
_owner_name_rule: Renne is SPELLED 'Renne' but PRONOUNCED like the US name 'Renee' (ruh-NAY). Neural TTS says 'Renee' correctly, so we substitute it in audio only.
